input.quote: 13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.
input.rationale: The licence package meets our preferred position in full, so no redline is warranted. § 13.1 grants the subscription rights to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (plus Authorized Users); § 13.2 makes paid-up software and embedded Vendor Technology licences perpetual and irrevocable for Customer and its Affiliates; § 13.3 bars Vendor from revoking or suspending a licence except for a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a cure opportunity, and permits Customer to transfer licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24 — and § 24.1 lets Customer assign without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or asset sale, so the successor-transfer path is real and unconditioned. § 13.4 restrictions are narrow (reverse engineering, interference, security bypass, unlawful use) and expressly do not limit authorized security testing or use of Customer Data and output. No affiliate written-notice gating or revocability at Vendor's discretion is present, so this sits above the fallback.
